notes: 1) Phase 1.5 literature search: related_search.py silently returns nothing for several concept queries (more than ~3 words or strict-mode cutoff removal), and 'verify' prints no abstract, so the Hard Rule that novelty statements must match a prior work's own abstract cannot be satisfied for papers like DMC; I relied on the paper's own description of Locret and marked what could not be verified. 2) The novelty script requires URLs for matches; I first typed placeholder/guessed URLs and had to correct them from kept_results.jsonl, so the instructions should say to copy URLs only from kept results. 3) The skill asks for five reviewers in one context when delegation is not allowed; independence is only by role and I disclosed that. 4) For a positive reviewer relying on an overstated point, the EIC-weight guidance (start at 1.0, move only for a verified paper-specific reason) was workable but leaves room: I lowered R3 to 0.75 for rating resting on single-example interpretability evidence. 5) The ICLR label from the script gives two scales in one string; the 'venue_recommendation' field had to be copied verbatim. 6) Figures were unavailable, so the headline math gains (198%, 58.4%, Figure 3) were left as unverifiable rather than errors. 7) No upheld DA-CRITICAL, so the 'da_critical' list is empty in both script runs. 8) Reviewer-run recomputation (e.g., LongMemEval overall from per-type accuracies) required external knowledge of question-type counts; I validated them by reproducing the other table rows.
